actual_scope: Sharp dimension-independent Gaussian-integer energy-ball packing: prove B=2R suffices for radius R, give the B=2R-1 collision, and source-test B=2^(K+1) on the three retained HPE literal pairs.
scope_change_reason: The drawn adversarial method is refined to a safe compiler boundary plus a sharp adjacent unsafe boundary. This follows the first positive baseline and explicitly uses the card's proof method as the single bounded pivot; it is not a finite smoke test in place of the quantified implication.
bottleneck_link: An exact all-dimension encoding lemma reduces integers in source-bound HPE equality checks by one more radix bit than PR1859 while preserving phase and full-row information. This is verifier arithmetic, not supplier or exponent improvement.
stop_rule: One approximately 60-minute session including setup. Stop after the written energy-ball proof, exhaustive small Gaussian balls, three literal pairs, and meaningful failure controls. No Lean build, selected-checker replacement or larger recipe census.
evidence: Written dimension-independent least-nonzero-digit kernel proof and sharp unsafe-radix construction; 3072 scaled rows, 5265 Gaussian-ball vectors, 11493 short-kernel vectors, 1024 unsafe radices, 30 differential executions and 15 source controls; four CLI/source/receipt boundary test groups.

ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical derivation, implementation, verification and prose. No subagents or independent human proof review.
